marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices staged a massive recovery on October 15, 2026, with the Nifty 50 rallying 374.65 points (+1.66%) to close at 22,997.35 and the Sensex surging 1,533.72 points (+2.11%) to settle at 74,315.61. The upmove was propelled by heavyweights across IT, Private Banks, and Energy following a ~2% drop in crude oil prices and currency firming. However, market breadth remained noticeably divergent as broader midcap and smallcap gauges ended in the red, indicating that swing traders should focus on institutional large-cap bases rather than extended beta plays.
dailyFocus: Focus on high relative-strength large-cap breakouts and post-earnings continuation setups in IT and select Capital Goods/Defence names with multi-year order backlogs, while keeping strict risk stops on midcaps undergoing valuation de-rating.

news.headline: Tech Mahindra Q2 Net Profit Jumps 33% YoY to ₹1,586 Crore; Board Approves 1:1 Bonus Issue
news.summary: Tech Mahindra delivered robust Q2FY27 performance with consolidated net profit jumping 33% YoY to ₹1,586 crore, driven by margin expansion in digital services. The Board declared an interim dividend of ₹15 per share and approved a 1:1 bonus issue, propelling the stock up 4.8% as the top Nifty gainer.
news.impact: High-volume momentum breakout off base resistance; ideal catalyst for multi-day continuation setups.

news.headline: Nifty 50 Rebounds 375 Points to Near 23,000 on Crude Pullback and IT Surge
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices posted their biggest single-day gain in four months on October 15, with the Nifty closing up 1.66% at 22,997.35. A ~2% drop in Brent crude prices and strong buying across frontline IT and banking heavyweights led the rally, despite underlying breadth lagging in mid/small caps.
news.impact: Provides a constructive index backdrop for swing trades, but warns against aggressive midcap exposure due to negative breadth.

news.headline: Nestle India Slumps Nearly 8% Despite 36% Profit Rise as Cash Flow Concerns Trigger De-rating
news.summary: Nestle India posted Q2FY27 consolidated net profit growth of 35.8% YoY to ₹1,010 crore on a 20.3% revenue jump, yet the stock skidded 7.8% on October 15. Institutional investors heavily discounted the result over slowing operating cash flow conversion and valuation resistance at current multiples.
news.impact: Violates key 50-DMA support on massive volume; invalidates bullish swing setups in the immediate term.

news.headline: HAL Expands Koraput Engine Capacity to 50/Year; Projected to Lead Q2 Defence Revenue Growth
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is scaling annual AL-31FP engine production capacity from 30 to 50 units with a ₹335 crore investment while establishing a second Shakti engine line. Concurrently, brokerage reports (JM Financial) project HAL to lead defence revenue growth in Q2FY27 with a 22% YoY increase driven by aircraft and helicopter deliveries.
news.impact: Clears multi-month execution bottleneck doubts; sets up a constructive base-on-base pattern ahead of earnings.

news.headline: CG Power Board Meeting Scheduled for October 23, 2026 to Approve Q2FY27 Results
news.summary: In an official disclosure to BSE and NSE on October 14, CG Power confirmed its Board of Directors will meet on Friday, October 23, 2026, to review and approve Q2FY27 financial results. The company heads into earnings backed by a robust order backlog that expanded over 45% YoY in recent quarters.
news.impact: Establishes a firm binary catalyst date (Oct 23); watch for volume contraction and volatility squeeze patterns into the print.

news.headline: Polycab Excluded from Equity Derivatives Segment Effective January 1, 2027
news.summary: BSE and NSE notified the exclusion of Polycab India Ltd from the equity derivatives segment from January 1, 2027, following a periodic review of SEBI eligibility criteria. Existing contracts expiring in October, November, and December 2026 will run to expiry, but no new contract months will be generated.
news.impact: Prompts gradual institutional unwinding and lower speculative liquidity over successive expiries, compressing swing breakout follow-through.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Wins Fresh Orders Worth ₹533 Crore Across Drones and Avionics
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited announced via exchange disclosures that it has secured additional orders worth ₹533 crore since September 17, 2026. The contracts encompass communication gear, electronic warfare suites, avionics, cybersecurity solutions, drones, and software solutions.
news.impact: Reinforces steady order-book replenishment; stock consolidating constructively just below prior resistance swing highs.

news.headline: SEBI Committee Backs Retaining 30-Minute VWAP for Derivatives Settlement
news.summary: SEBI's Secondary Market Advisory Committee favoured retaining the standard 30-minute volume-weighted average price (VWAP) for calculating expiry-day derivatives settlement prices, deferring an immediate transition to the Closing Auction Session (CAS) formula following feedback regarding expiry swings.
news.impact: Reduces end-of-day artificial pin-risk on expiry days, restoring predictable technical closes for swing position holders.

news.headline: NSE Adds Data Patterns and Five Other Stocks to F&O Segment Effective October 28
news.summary: The National Stock Exchange issued a circular announcing the inclusion of six new stocks in the Futures & Options segment effective October 28, 2026, including defence electronics player Data Patterns (India), Karur Vysya Bank, and Coromandel International, subject to quarter sigma fulfillment.
news.impact: Drives immediate institutional liquidity inflows and wider participation, increasing breakout velocity in base patterns.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Arm Secures Luxury Vessel Order; Navy Commissions INS Mangrol
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard subsidiary Hooghly-CSL secured an order valued between ₹100-250 crore from Heritage River Journeys for two luxury cruise vessels. In addition, the Indian Navy commissioned the CSL-built anti-submarine warfare shallow-water craft INS Mangrol on October 12, validating naval deliveries.
news.impact: Aids accumulation in an extended multi-week base around ₹1,250-1,270, though volume confirmation is required for a clean breakout.

news.headline: Trent Sets Board Meeting for October 29 Following Milestone 1,000th Zudio Store Addition
news.summary: Trent Ltd scheduled its board meeting for October 29, 2026, to approve Q2FY27 financial results. The announcement follows a Q2 business update that saw 23% YoY standalone revenue growth to ₹5,788 crore and the inauguration of its 1,000th Zudio outlet, bringing total store footprint to 1,342.
news.impact: High-tight flag consolidation near lifetime highs; volume dry-up before October 29 makes it a prime watch candidate.
